# Nicolas Peters Saa

> AI engineer and M.Sc. Innovation Management student at HSBA Hamburg, studying in a dual programme with IBM (Technology Lifecycle Services sales). IBM Quantum Associate Ambassador and freelance Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs consultant for medical software and healthcare. Based in Hamburg, Germany.

He combines regulatory and quality management expertise with hands-on AI development and value engineering: intelligent automation, data pipelines and AI-powered products where healthcare and technology meet. 3+ years in AI / ML, 10+ projects built, 6 professional roles.

Contact: email nicolaspeterssaa@gmail.com · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicolas-peters-saa-635a501bb (preferred for project inquiries) · GitHub https://github.com/Nodolas
Open to collaborations, talks and quantum conversations.

## Hackathons

### Entry Scout: 3rd place, 3 hours
- Event: Build It Anyway: Signal Hunt with Apify, #SFTechWeek, European Startup Embassy, San Francisco, Fri 9 Oct 2026 (10:00-15:00 PT). The build time was 3 hours.
- What it does: enter a company and AI agents map each product to where EU public buyers are heading. It uses 161 labelled EU TED awards, web and social signals collected with 6 Apify scrapers, and open tenders, then returns a source-tagged brief and a draft outreach email. The award data bank is labelled by the extraction engine from Nicolas's HSBA master's thesis.
- Live demo: https://nodolas.github.io/entry-scout-demo/
- Recap (the story of the day, the MVP and the lessons): https://nodolas.github.io/entry-scout-demo/story/
- Build it out fully: Entry Scout is a 3-hour prototype with a fictional vendor and recorded agent runs. To have it built into a complete product, contact Nicolas Peters Saa on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicolas-peters-saa-635a501bb

### Overmind GSM8K: 6th place, 2 days
- Event: "Small Model, Big Maths", San Francisco, Oct 2026. Score = % of the 1,319 GSM8K test questions solved minus model size in billions of parameters.
- Result: 91.89% - 4.66B = 87.23 (winning score 89.95), light LoRA on Qwen3.5-4B, 52 training runs.
- Retrospective: https://nodolas.github.io/gsm8k-retrospective/

### Phision (Test Flight): no placement, 2 days
- Event: Glasswing Ventures Enterprise-Ready AI Hackathon, Boston AI Week, 26-27 Sep 2026. Team of five. Event page: https://aiweek.boston/schedule/glasswing-ventures-enterprise-ready-ai-hackathon
- What it does: a pharma quality-intelligence agent that rebuilds an incident across plant systems, stress-tests the suspected root cause and hands QA an evidence-cited investigation. Nicolas built the fictional generics manufacturer and its data (records, quality events and a planted root cause).
- Live product: https://glasswing-hackathon.vercel.app/
- Recap: https://nodolas.github.io/hackathon-recap-glasswing/

## IBM Quantum
- Ambassador: translates qubits, error mitigation and Qiskit into language boards, clients and regulators understand, and brings quantum-safe thinking into enterprise IT conversations.
- Q-Day readiness: helps teams understand the risk that large quantum computers break today's public-key cryptography ("harvest now, decrypt later"), find where their cryptography lives, and plan the move to post-quantum standards.
- Use cases: separates real quantum opportunities (optimisation, molecule and materials simulation, quantum machine learning) from hype and builds roadmaps.
